about_title: Your Trusted Partner in Global Logistics
about_p1: At EthioLink Logistics and Handling PLC we provide integrated logistics, customs clearance, freight forwarding and supply chain solutions that facilitate the efficient movement of goods across local and international markets.
about_p2: Through professional service, regulatory compliance and customs-focused solutions we simplify logistics processes and help businesses move their cargo with confidence, reliability and efficiency.
services_intro: From the moment your cargo arrives to the moment it reaches its destination, we handle every step — compliantly, securely and on time.
services_page_intro: Eight specialised services, one accountable partner. Whatever you need to clear, store, consolidate or move, our team plans it around your goods, your timeline and the rules that apply.
svc_customs_short: Fast, compliant clearance for imports, exports and goods in transit through Ethiopia.
svc_customs_body: We prepare and file every declaration, manage duties and tariffs, and coordinate with customs authorities so your shipments clear without delays or penalties. For cargo passing through Ethiopia to neighbouring markets, we handle transit documentation from entry point to exit.
svc_storage_short: Secure storage for goods awaiting customs inspection and release.
svc_storage_body: While your cargo completes the clearance process, we keep it in secure, supervised storage that meets customs requirements — protected, documented and ready for release the moment it is cleared.
svc_bonded_short: Hold dutiable goods with duties deferred until they leave the warehouse.
svc_bonded_body: Our bonded warehousing service lets you keep imported goods under customs control without paying duties upfront. Release them in stages as your market demands, improving cash flow while your stock stays secure and fully accounted for.
svc_consolidation_short: Combine smaller shipments into full loads to reduce cost.
svc_consolidation_body: We group smaller shipments from multiple suppliers into consolidated container and truck loads, cutting freight costs and handling, and simplifying the paperwork for every consignment.
svc_forwarding_short: Professional packing and forwarding by sea, air and land.
svc_forwarding_body: From export-grade packing and labelling to booking space with carriers, we prepare your goods properly and move them by the best route — sea, air or land — with the documentation handled at every step.
svc_trade_short: End-to-end support for businesses trading across borders.
svc_trade_body: We guide importers and exporters through permits, documentation and trade compliance, and coordinate the logistics at both ends, so your goods move between Ethiopia and international markets with confidence.
svc_consultancy_short: Expert advice on routes, regulations and supply chain decisions.
svc_consultancy_body: Drawing on decades of experience in shipping, ports and trade, our team advises on the right routes, modes and procedures, helps you navigate regulations, and finds opportunities to reduce cost and risk.
svc_contracting_short: Dedicated transport and warehousing arranged around your operations.
svc_contracting_body: For businesses with ongoing volumes, we arrange contracted transport and warehousing capacity tailored to your schedule — dependable service, predictable costs and a single partner accountable for performance.
mission_text: To empower businesses to expand globally by delivering freight forwarding, compliant customs clearance and secure warehousing solutions tailored to each client's unique needs.
vision_text: To be the most reliable and innovative global logistics and customs partner, setting the benchmark for efficiency, transparency and sustainable supply chain management worldwide.
value_integrity_text: We strictly adhere to trade laws and standard operating procedures, protecting your business and reputation at every step.
value_excellence_text: We commit to timely deliveries, meticulous cargo handling and proactive problem solving.
value_customer_text: Your business goals are ours. We customise our services to match your exact operational requirements.
value_innovation_text: Leveraging modern tracking technologies and optimised routes to keep your supply chain moving without delays.
value_transparency_text: Clear pricing, real-time updates and open communication.
why_endtoend_text: A single point of contact for your logistics, from the factory floor to final delivery.
why_network_text: Strategic partnerships across major sea, air and land routes worldwide.
why_regulatory_text: In-depth knowledge of local and international trade compliance laws.
why_tracking_text: Transparency and visibility over your shipments every step of the way.
